versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-hot-list.

- Provides four main commands to fetch and analyze public Xiaohongshu (小红书) data: note search, note detail, note comments, and author posts.
- Handles user inputs for keywords, note links, and author profile links to retrieve corresponding data.
- Command-line parameters allow filtering by type, sort order, time range, and result limit.
- Includes detailed documentation on usage scenarios, parameter explanations, error handling, and platform rules.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for access; runs on Node.js 16.14.0+.
